purpose: Verify standalone Depot CI persistent disk, real mount, sequential source-bound persistence, fresh sandbox marker isolation, disjoint fan-out writers, peer reads and post cleanup
scope: Isolated trial branch and uniquely named disk only
source: Committed workflow, inline mise tasks and source checkout bound in per-job proof
preconditions: Push committed branch before Depot dispatch to prevent local patch injection
Verify no pre-existing private job marker and no pre-existing mount
Require preinstalled Archil, record version/hash and reject the floating installer path
Require the same Archil hash after mounting
Never read or mutate another disk name
network: Repository checkout, pinned action and Node bootstrap, scoped sandbox disk metadata, mounted Depot cache disk, artifact upload
credentials: Existing repository read permission, sandbox-issued job disk token handled by the pinned action; no user/org secret created or exported
outputs: Whitelisted preflight and consumer JSON, artifact metadata/digests, provider job/attempt metadata and full post-step logs
cleanup: Pinned action unmount and token release; preserve both outcomes. Disk payload intentionally retained under its unique name for provider retention; no shared-cache deletion or retention-setting change.
excluded: No dependency-cache speed estimate, no whole-repository build, no subscription/settings/account-wide/invoice access, no guarantee of arbitrary concurrent tool-cache mutation safety
